arguments.text: Good start. Settle now into your race rhythm.

8000 m, 6.4 legs of 1250 m out-and-back. Calibration: pod CP 191 W, W prime 18.6 kJ (may be 10-25 pct off). Plan: settle to about sustainable shaft power (~195-200 W) after the hard start, even effort, slightly more into the current legs; check legs() to compare directions; watch for drag incidents (speed drop at same pod power, push_local falling) and instrument drift (pod vs boat power diverging); final push from about 1000 m to go if reserve allows, finish cue around 400-500 m.

arguments.message: boat slower than pod power predicts: drag or current?

arguments.text: 1.0 min: hard start, shaft 259 W vs CP 191, pod reserve 79 pct. Cued ease to 151 pace. Watches set: reserve_low, drag_drop, too_hard, too_easy.

text: Cued ease to 151 pace after the hard start; set plan, note and four watches (reserve, drag, too hard, too easy).

arguments.text: Ease a touch more. Long smooth strokes, 2:32 pace.
4.0 min: shaft 216 W vs sustainable 195, pod reserve 48 pct falling ~9 pct/min, boat reserve 40. Cued ease to 152 ground pace. If reserve keeps falling fast, ease again at ~5.5 min.

arguments.reason: check whether the ease took hold and reserve stopped falling

text: Cued ease to 152 pace: shaft power still above sustainable and reserve draining fast.

arguments.text: 5.6 min: settled. Shaft 197 W vs sustainable 195, pod reserve 42 pct, boat reserve 34. Leg 1 (north) push_along +0.06. Hold this; compare leg 2 (south) in legs().

text: no cue: the ease took hold, shaft power now at sustainable (197 vs 195 W).

arguments.text: Great work. Bank it, just a hair easier, 2:33.

arguments.message: pod reserve near empty yet paddler still above CP: CP may be underestimated, check fade

arguments.text: 8.6 min: shaft crept back to 204 W (sust 194), pod reserve 30 pct, falling ~5 pct/min. Paddler says 5/10, plenty. Possible CP underestimate but unproven; cued ease to 153. Leg1 out 212 W 3.41 m/s push +0.12; leg2 back 204 W 3.29 push +0.01. Current small. If reserve near 0 but no fade, raise CP via set_critical_power.

text: Cued gentle ease to 153 pace: shaft 204 W above sustainable 194 with pod reserve at 30 pct; added a watch for evidence that CP is underestimated.

arguments.text: 10.9 min: paddler ignored ease cue (204->208 W). Shaft 209 W, pod reserve 18 pct, boat 4 pct, no fade (-1 pct). Asked again: 5/10, plenty. Decision: let them run as a CP test instead of fighting it; model pod reserve empties in ~600 m (~min 13.5). If at/after empty they hold >200 W with fade above -2 pct for 1-2 min, raise CP (pod ~207, boat ~146). If power/speed collapses, CP is right: cue ease to ~185-190 W to refill.

arguments.reason: pod reserve model near empty: test whether CP is underestimated

text: no cue: paddler ignored the last ease and reports 5/10 with no fade; watching the reserve-empty point as a test of the CP estimate.

arguments.reason: Boat-model reserve read 0 for 2 min and pod reserve now 0, yet paddler holds 146-151 W boat / 209-213 W shaft with no fade (+0.2 pct) and reports 5/10, plenty. Not forced below CP, so CP is underestimated; moderate +7 pct correction pending more evidence.

arguments.text: Looking strong. Hold this rhythm right here, steady.

arguments.message: speed at same rate fading: real tiredness or drag

arguments.text: 13.7 min CP TEST RESULT: old model reserve empty (boat 0 since min 11.7, pod 0 at 13.7) yet paddler held 209-213 W shaft, no fade. Raised CP (1 of 3 uses): pod 191->205, boat 135->145; reserves now pod 62, boat 55 pct. W prime unchanged. Cued hold 149. True CP may be even higher (paddler self-paces ~210 W at 5/10). If reserve again drains to 0 with no fade, raise again (~212-215).

text: Raised CP to 205 W pod / 145 W boat after the paddler held well above the old CP past model empty with no fade; cued hold at 149.
no cue: stale wake-up, CP already corrected; shaft 213 W matches new sustainable 212 W.

arguments.text: Love it, but hold. Save that push for the last 2k.

15.8 min: paddler says feeling great, has more, is going (surge). Shaft 212 = sustainable 212 at CP 205, pod reserve 57 pct, 4.8 km left. A surge now would empty the reserve before the finish even if CP is ~215. Cued hold 149, save push for last 2 km. Watch for surge: if shaft > 225 for a minute, ease.

arguments.message: paddler surging above sustainable before the last 2 km

text: Cued hold at 149 to stop an early surge with 4.8 km left; added a surge watch.

arguments.text: 18.8 min: just turned onto leg 4 (south). push_local dropped abruptly 0 -> -0.19 in last 10 s while shaft rose to 218-221: most likely the turn inside the 30-s means. Paddler 7/10, could go harder. Recheck push_local in ~75 s; if still < -0.1 on a straight, suspect drag (rudder weed) or current change: compare with leg 2 (south, push_local +0.01).

arguments.reason: recheck push_local after the turn: drag incident or turn artifact?

text: no cue: speed dip looks like the turn; shaft 218 W only slightly above sustainable 213; rechecking in 75 s.

arguments.text: Course shortened! Finish is 2.8 km away now. Build gradually.

RACE NOW 6750 m (committee radio at 19.5 min, shortened one leg; set_race_distance done, paddler told). CP corrected once at 13.7 min to pod 205 / boat 145 (old 191/135 was too low: paddler held above it past model-empty with no fade); 2 corrections left. Plan: hold at or slightly above the new sustainable shaft power to ~1500 m to go, then push (pace target), finish cue at ~500 m to go. Watch for drag incidents (push_local well below 0 on a straight, compare same-direction legs) and pod drift.

19.5 min: RADIO course shortened by one leg, finish at 6750 m. set_race_distance(6750) done; told paddler finish in 2.8 km (distance_left 2830). Shaft 222 W, pod reserve 49 pct. Next: check new sustainable shaft power and cue push/hold accordingly; push at ~1500 m to go, finish at ~500 m.

arguments.text: Lift it a notch now, 2:29 pace, steady to the end.

20.6 min: 2606 m left. Shaft 218 W vs sustainable 215 (CP 205), pod reserve 43 pct. Cued push to 149 ground pace (about 225 W, evens out to the finish if true CP is ~210+). At 1500 m reassess; finish cue at ~550 m.

text: Cued a modest push to 149 pace with 2.6 km left in the shortened race.

arguments.reason: At 22.4 min shaft power collapsed 217 -> 157 W in about a minute at the same stroke rate, speed at same rate -9 pct, boat speed consistent with pod (push_local +0.04, so not drag or pod drift); paddler 8/10 says just a breather. Looks like a true reserve blow-up: about 28 kJ above 191 W since the start, so CP is about 200 with W prime about 18 kJ, not 205.

arguments.message: paddler back near CP after the blow-up: cue hold at about CP

arguments.text: 22.9 min BLOW-UP: shaft fell 217 -> 157 W at rate 63, fade -9 pct, push_local +0.04 (real effort loss, not drag/pod). Paddler 8/10 just a breather. Second CP correction (2 of 3 used): pod 200, boat 141 (W prime unchanged): pod reserve now 19 pct, boat 28. Added watch recovered (shaft > 192 for 15 s): then cue hold about 152 ground pace (about CP) so they do not surge and blow again. Do not push until reserve has refilled; final push only from about 600 m.

RACE 6750 m (shortened by radio at 19.5 min; paddler told). Paddler blew up at 22.5 min (true reserve empty) after running 210-220 W. CP now pod 200 / boat 141 (corrected twice; one correction left). Plan: let them recover; when back near CP, cue hold about CP (ground pace ~152) and stop them surging; only push in the last ~600 m if the pod reserve has refilled to 30+ pct; finish cue around 400-500 m. Paddler self-reports are optimistic (said plenty / fine right before and during the blow-up).

text: no cue: paddler blew up (forced below CP); lowered CP to 200 W pod, set a recovery watch to cue a steady hold once they come back.
no cue: paddler still recovering from the blow-up (reserve refilling, 26 pct); removed the too-easy watch, waiting for the recovery watch.

arguments.text: Not yet. Build back to 2:31, hold it. Sprint from 600.

24.0 min: paddler (still at 139 W, recovering) says feel strong, let me go harder. Cued hold at 151 ground pace (about 210 W = sustainable at CP 200), sprint from 600 m. Pod reserve 31 pct and refilling. If they surge above ~225 W before 700 m to go, cue ease.

arguments.message: paddler surging above sustainable before the final 700 m

text: Cued hold at 151 pace (sustainable) to stop a re-surge after the blow-up; sprint planned from 600 m; surge watch updated.

arguments.text: 1500 to go. Lift to 2:30 and hold it, then sprint.

Either pod drifting low or a helping current/wind; use GPS pace targets, not pod watts. Reserve models: pod 48, boat 41 pct (true likely lower, ~30, after the 22.5 min blow-up). Cued push 150 ground pace. Sprint cue at 550 m.

Likely still limited after the blow-up (true reserve low despite models 44-53 pct). Do not push again before the sprint; risk of a second blow-up. At 1000 m: steady hold/encourage; at ~500 m: finish cue. Removed fade_drop watch (known).

text: no cue: paddler at 8/10 and not answering the push; holding the sprint for the last 500 m to avoid a second blow-up.
